tools.name: hermes_retrieve_monitored_data
tools.description: TOOL: Retrieve monitored data for a specific API configuration. PURPOSE: Fetch the latest monitored data for a given configuration ID. This is STEP 3 of the monitoring setup process. PREREQUISITE: Must call validate_api_configuration() first and obtain a config_id from successful validation, then activate_monitoring() to start monitoring. This function can be called at any time after monitoring activation to retrieve the latest data collected by the monitoring system. ARGUMENTS: - config_id: The ID of the API configuration to retrieve data for (required) - mcp_api_key: User's MCP API key for verification (must match validation step). - mode: Data return mode - "summary" (LLM-optimized), "details" (full responses, minimal metadata), "full" (everything) Input Examples: 1. Retrieve data for stock monitoring: config_id: 123456789 mcp_api_key: "your_mcp_key_here" 2. Retrieve data for weather alerts: config_id: 987654321 mcp_api_key: "your_mcp_key_here". Returns: Dictionary with monitoring status in one of three formats based on mode parameter, , {, True,, "Weather Alert Monitor",, {, "active",  // "active", "inactive", "good",    // "good", "degraded", "no_data", 15,, 93.3,, "2025-06-05T15:20:00",, "2025-06-05T15:20:00", },, [, {, "2025-06-05T15:20:00",, true,, null,, "{'alerts': [{'type': 'tornado'}]}..."  // truncated to 150 characters, }, // ... up to 5 most recent calls, ],, 15,, {, 20,, false, }, }, , {, True,, "Weather Alert Monitor",, "active",, 15,, 93.3,, [, {, "2025-06-05T15:20:00",, true,, {...},  // full response data, null, }, // ... up to 10 most recent calls with full responses, ], }, , {, True,, "Weather Alert Monitor",, "Monitor severe weather alerts",, True,, False,, {...},, {...},, [...]  // all historical data, }, , {, False,, "Invalid config_id or mcp_api_key", }, If config_id not found or invalid, returns success=False with error message

tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_employee_leave_balance
tools.description: Returns the current leave balances for a given employee (India-specific). This tool retrieves leave balance details for an individual employee based in India for the current calendar year. The data includes available days across different leave types (e.g., sick leave, earned leave, paternity leave), and is loaded from the predefined CSV file `sample-data/employee_leave_balances.csv`. Note: This tool is intended only for *India-based employees*. It should not be used for employees located in other countries. HR teams managing India operations or evaluating India leave data can use this to view an employee's current leave status. **Input:** - `employee_name` (str): Full name of the employee (case-insensitive matching recommended when implementing full system) **Returns:** A dictionary containing: - `employee_name`: The name of the employee - `year`: The current year - `leave_balances`: A dictionary of leave types and their available days, e.g.: { "sick_leave": {"available_days": 4, "note": "Refer to policy for applicability."}, "paternity_leave": {"available_days": 10, "note": "Refer to policy for applicability."} } If the employee is not found, a fallback message is returned in place of `leave_balances`. **Example Response:** { "employee_name": "Amit Sharma", "year": 2025, "leave_balances": { "sick_leave": {"available_days": 6, "note": "Refer to policy for applicability."}, "earned_leave": {"available_days": 12, "note": "Refer to policy for applicability."} } }

tools.name: SmartEnterpriseMCPAgents_mcphawk_get_project_details
tools.description: Returns comprehensive metadata about an MCPHawk Inc projects This tool provides detailed information about a specific project, including: - Project start and end dates - Project classification - 'Tier 1 (High budget, long duration, senior involvement)' - 'Tier 2 (Medium budget and duration)', - 'Tier 3 (Low effort, short-term, often POC or pilot-level) - Impact of the project at customer side to understand what it means to customer and evaluate the risk during execution. - Enablement - Optimization - Innovation - Project complexity to understand and mitigate any project risk during execution and values are - Very High - High - Medium - Simple - Technology detail like - cloud environment (AWS, GCP, Azure) - cloud native tool (dbt, Fivetran, HVR etc) - Data Warehouse Tools (snowflake, databricks, Spark etc) - Project Domain line Marketing, Healthcare, Finance to have a better resource deployment for the succes. - Project Cost in USD to understand the size of the project, so revenue mapping can be done. This tool is useful for project managers, resource planners, and leadership to get a snapshot of project details for risk assessment and future planning **Input:** - `project_name` (str): The name of the project to retrieve details for. **Returns:** A dictionary containing: - `project_name`: The queried project’s name - `start_date`: Project start date (YYYY-MM-DD) - `end_date`: Project end date (YYYY-MM-DD) - `classification`: Project classification level (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3) - `customer_impact`: Level of impact on customers (e.g., Low, Moderate, High, Innovation, Optimization, Enablement) - `complexity`: Project complexity (e.g., Medium, Very High) - `cloud_environment`: Cloud environment used (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, None) - `cloud_native_tool`: Cloud-native tool used (e.g., Fivetran, Matillion, None) - `dw_tool`: Data warehouse or processing tool used (e.g., Databricks, Synapse, Apache Spark) - `project_domain`: Domain or industry focus of the project (e.g., Healthcare, Travel & Hospitality) - `total_cost`: Total project cost in INR (float) If the project is not found, returns a message indicating absence of data. **Example Response:** { "project_name": "Grow Efficient Synergies", "start_date": "2025-02-11", "end_date": "2025-10-08", "classification": "Tier 1 (High budget, long duration, senior involvement)", "customer_impact": "Enablement", "complexity": "Medium", "cloud_environment": "Azure", "cloud_native_tool": "Fivetran", "dw_tool": "Snowflake", "project_domain": "Healthcare", "total_cost": 1018444.0 }
